title: SAP Global Enterprise Operations Engineer
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced SAP Technical SME \- Basis \& HANA Operations to lead and govern SAP technical operations within our SAP RISE landscape. The role will act as the primary technical authority for SAP Basis, HANA Database Administration, SAP cloud operations, and service governance, ensuring stable, secure, compliant, and high\-performing SAP environments.
   

  

 The candidate will serve as the bridge between internal business teams, SAP RISE managed services, hosting providers, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity, and application support teams to drive service excellence, operational stability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

**Major Accountabilities**
**SAP Basis, HANA, Technical \& RISE Operations**
* Act as the technical SME for SAP Basis and HANA operations across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Fiori, and related SAP systems.
* Hand\-on SAP HANA database administration activities.Oversee day\-to\-day SAP operations delivered through SAP RISE and managed service providers.
* Manage system availability, performance, capacity planning, and technical health of SAP landscapes.
* Review and govern SAP service delivery against agreed SLAs, KPIs, and operational objectives.
* Lead technical issue resolution and support major incident management activities.
* Drive root cause analysis and implementation of preventive actions.
* Serve as primary liaison with SAP RISE teams for infrastructure, platform, and technical operations.
* Govern SAP RISE service delivery, support escalations, and service review meetings.
* Ensure adherence to SAP RISE operational processes, change management, and release schedules.
* Drive optimization initiatives for HANA performance and resource utilization.


**Security, Compliance \& Audit Support.**
* Collaborate with SAP Security, Cybersecurity, and Compliance teams to ensure secure operation of SAP platforms.
* Support audit readiness and compliance requirements.
* Ensure implementation of SAP security notes and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Support GxP, SOX, and other regulatory requirements where applicable.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Partner with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, SAP functional teams, and vendors.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance during projects, migrations, and transformation initiatives.
* Support SAP strategy, roadmap development, and cloud adoption initiatives.
* Mentor junior Basis administrators and technical analysts


**Minimum Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* 12\+ years of SAP Technical, Basis Administration, SAP RISE experience.
* Strong experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP HANA Administration.
* Experience managing SAP environments hosted on cloud platforms through SAP RISE.
* Experience with SAP Solution Manager, Cloud ALM, Focused Run, or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Strong incident, problem, and change management experience.
* Experience working in globally distributed support organizations and GCC environments.
* SAP Certified Technology Associate or SAP Basis Certification.
* SAP HANA Administration Certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
* Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Manufacturing, or other regulated industry experience is a plus but not mandatory.
* Exposure to GxP\-compliant or validated environments is advantageous.


**Skills**
* SAP Basis and HANA operations \& Governance
* Experience managing SAP environments hosted on cloud platforms through SAP RISE.
* Experience in backup \- recovery, disaster recovery, and high availability activities.
* Hand\-on experiences in SAP System Upgrades, Patching \& Release Management.
* Experience with SAP Solution Manager, Cloud ALM, Focused Run, or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Stakeholder Management
* Technical Leadership \&Supplier Management.
* Problem Solving \& Root Cause Analysis


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**
**\#Sandoz**

title: Engr IV-Security Engineering
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

****What you’ll be doing...****
 The Verizon Cyber Security Team is looking for a highly skilled Security Engineer (Engr IV) to drive our Red Team and Adversary Simulation capability within Technology Product Development (TPD). In this role, you will elevate our offensive security posture beyond standard vulnerability discovery. Your mission is to rigorously test our organization's People, Processes, and Technology against realistic, advanced threats. We do not exist merely to find missing patches; we act as a catalyst to ensure Verizon is resilient against the threats of tomorrow.
   

  

 This team rejects the notion that Red Teaming is defined by a checklist of scanners. We are looking for a true builder\-hacker hybrid—someone who natively speaks the language of modern software engineering and treats offensive operations as an engineering discipline. You will prioritize strategy over tooling, emulating adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) to test our Threat Management Center's (TMC) detection pipelines. You will operate as a true partner, culminating campaigns with collaborative Purple Team exercises to empower developers to build secure, resilient products from the ground up while enforcing strict cyber hygiene across the enterprise.
   

  

* Execute Adversary Simulations: Design and execute complex, objective\-based Red Team campaigns modeled on real\-world adversaries targeting the telecom industry, utilizing the MITRE ATT\&CK framework.
* Target Modern Architectures \& AI Ecosystems: Focus attacks on the modern software supply chain, full\-stack applications (Node, Angular, Java), and cloud environments. Participate in offensive engagements against AI\-driven applications, including testing Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, custom LLM agents, and human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) validations.
* Validate Cyber Hygiene \& Compliance: Look beyond complex exploit chains to identify and expose systemic failures in foundational cyber hygiene. Map campaign findings against enterprise security policies and regulatory compliance requirements to prove where technical controls are failing.
* AI\-Augmented Offensive Operations: Actively leverage generative AI and modern tooling to accelerate vulnerability research, automate custom payload generation, and enhance red team workflows.
* Test Detection and Response: Operate with stealth and precision to evaluate Verizon's logging, alerting, and incident response pipelines in real\-time, focusing on "Living off the Land" methodologies.
* Drive True Purple Teaming: Embrace a Gray/White\-box methodology by collaborating closely with product and development teams. Conduct post\-campaign replay exercises with the Blue Team and developers to build robust detection rules and secure coding practices.
* Manage Attack Infrastructure as Code: Deploy and maintain dedicated, external cloud attack infrastructure (AWS/GCP) off\-network using automated CI/CD pipelines to mirror sophisticated threat actors.
* Enforce Uncompromising RoE: Adhere to explicit Rules of Engagement, ensure comprehensive asset inventories, and maintain strict operational safety and legal compliance during all engagements.
* Mentorship \& Collaboration: Provide technical guidance and peer mentorship to junior Red Team operators and penetration testers.


**What We’re Looking For…**
 You’ll need to have:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree with four or more years of work experience in a relevant security field.
* Four or more years of dedicated, hands\-on experience in Red Teaming, adversary simulation, or advanced penetration testing.
* Should have one of these core offensive security certifications: OSCP, CRTO, CRTP, or GXPN.
* Understanding of the MITRE ATT\&CK framework, Threat Intelligence integration, and APT emulation, including experience bypassing modern EDR/XDR solutions.
* Development experience with enterprise tech stacks (specifically Node.js, Angular, and Java) to conduct white\-box source code reviews, exploit complex web applications, and build bespoke attack tooling.
* Applied knowledge of AI security risks and usage, including prompt engineering, LLM jailbreaking, manipulating AI agent frameworks/APIs (e.g., MCP), and using AI models to accelerate offensive workflows.
* Knowledge of enterprise cyber hygiene principles, industry security frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, CIS Controls), and experience translating offensive findings into actionable data for compliance, risk, and audit stakeholders.
* Expertise in configuring and safely utilizing Command and Control (C2\) frameworks (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Mythic, Sliver).
* Demonstrated experience in collaborative Purple Teaming, translating technical attack narratives into actionable detection engineering rules.


 Even better if you have one or more of the following:
   

  

* A Master's degree in a relevant technical field.
* In\-depth knowledge of securing and attacking cloud\-native architectures, containerization platforms (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Highly recognized advanced certifications such as OSEP, OSWE, OSED, or advanced cloud security architecture certifications.
* Proficiency in programming and scripting languages (such as C\#, C\+\+, Go, Rust, Python, Bash, or PowerShell) to develop custom implants, droppers, and evasive tooling.
* A solid understanding of continuous attack surface management methodologies and advanced OSINT collection.
* Familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks relevant to the telecommunications industry (e.g., SOX, PCI\-DSS, CPNI).
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear, actionable risks for management and engineering teams.


 If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
   

  

 Where you’ll be working
   

  

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
   

  

 Scheduled Weekly Hours
   

  

 40
   

  

 Equal Employment Opportunity
   

  

 Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Lead Engineer - Cloud Engineering
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
**About the Role**
 We are looking for a hands\-on AWS Lead Engineer to lead cloud modernization, engineering excellence, and AI\-driven innovation for our Provider Payments platform. This role will work across all Provider Engineering Pods, driving scalable solutions, reusable capabilities, and modernization of healthcare payment systems while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of secure, scalable, cloud\-native solutions on AWS.
* Drive modernization of .NET applications into microservices and event\-driven architectures.
* Partner across all Provider Engineering Pods to establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices.
* Champion AI\-driven engineering practices to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, observability, and operational efficiency.
* Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and cloud transformation initiatives.
* Mentor engineers and promote a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, and Operations teams to deliver business outcomes.
* Drive operational excellence through automation, reliability engineering, and proactive monitoring.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong AWS experience with EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, IAM, and VPC.
* Deep expertise in.NET Core / .NET 6\+, C\#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of Microservices, Event\-Driven Architecture, Domain\-Driven Design, and API\-first development.
* Experience with SQL Server, NoSQL databases, messaging platforms, and high\-volume transaction systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform/CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of cloud security, authentication, authorization, and secure engineering practices.
* Experience building highly available and resilient payment platforms.


**AI\-Driven Engineering Mindset**
* Passion for leveraging AI and GenAI tools to accelerate software development lifecycle activities.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools for coding, testing, code reviews, documentation, and engineering productivity.
* Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve operational efficiency, developer experience, and platform intelligence.
* Drive a culture of experimentation, automation, and data\-driven decision making.
* Curiosity to continuously learn emerging AI capabilities and apply them responsibly within engineering teams.


 Domain Experience
   

  

**Preferred Experience In**
* Provider Payments
* Healthcare Claims
* Payment Integrity
* Revenue Cycle Management
* Healthcare Financial Platforms


 Behavioral Competencies
   

  

* Ownership mindset with strong accountability.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority.
* Growth mindset and passion for mentoring others.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving results.
* Customer\-focused with a bias for action and execution excellence.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 8\-12 years of software engineering experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience in AWS and .NET technologies.
* Experience leading cloud modernization and large\-scale engineering initiatives.
* Agile delivery experience and strong cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* AWS certifications preferred.


 Ideal Candidate: A technology leader with deep AWS and .NET expertise, healthcare payment domain knowledge, an AI\-first engineering mindset, and the ability to influence and collaborate across all Provider Engineering Pods while living Zelis' IMPACT values.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:

 Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
   

  

 Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

 We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day, which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. At Arcadis, you will have the opportunity to build the career that is right for you. And, as a ‘people ﬁrst’ business, it is why we will take the time to listen, to understand what you want from your time here, and provide the support you need to achieve your ambitions.
